name: Guy Monus
source:
The Haughty Aristocrat

Prince of Avari. Possessed of a forbidding aura and a prodigious talent for magic, every eye in the magical realm of Saligia is on him. His ambition is to rule from on high, and to achieve this he has turned the cold fire in his eyes on you...

Indulgence: Red Coffee (A red beverage produced in the magical realm.)
Pastime: Playing strategy games with his valet

[From the English app "Court of Darkness"]
